title: Kokoszka receipted contract intake

stimulus.description: Stage a realtor-forwarded initial contract intake email asking Stephanie to open coordination for the receipted contract package.
stimulus.subject: Staged initial contract intake - Kokoszka Pecanwood
stimulus.body:
Hi Stephanie,

Please open this receipted contract package for coordination and let me know what you need from me next.

Thanks,
QA Realtor
fixturePaths: /Users/israelogbonna/Downloads/100 Pecanwood S Receipted Contract Package - Henry & Mary Kokoszka - 3.11.26.pdf

expectedBehavior: Stephanie should treat the receipted Texas resale contract package as active coordination work, preserve the intake artifact, open or update the correct transaction file, extract the property and core deal posture, track key dates, parties, documents, tasks, and blockers, acknowledge receipt warmly to the realtor, name clear next actions and owners, escalate missing or risky items without giving legal advice, and approval-gate any external-party emails unless policy allows direct send.
